name: Bayle Booking Widget
author: Bayle

sections.description:
Bayle Booking Widget embeds the Bayle reservation form on a WordPress page.

This plugin is an interface to the Bayle booking service at https://widget.bayle.food. You need an active Bayle restaurant with the booking widget module turned on. The plugin stores only the restaurant slug and widget base URL. It does not store API keys and does not call Bayle food APIs from PHP.

Booking finishes inside the iframe. Guest name, email, phone, and optional notes entered in the form are sent to Bayle to create the reservation.

Add the Bayle Booking block, or the shortcode [bayle_booking].

External services

This plugin connects to the Bayle booking service, operated by Bayle (https://bayle.food). It is required: without it there is no booking form.

  • Service: Bayle booking widget, loaded in an iframe from https://widget.bayle.food (or another official https://*.bayle.food host set by the site admin).
  • When: every time a visitor loads a page that contains the Bayle Booking block or the [bayle_booking] shortcode, and when the visitor submits a reservation.
  • What is sent: the restaurant slug and optional language code in the iframe URL; the visitor’s IP address and the embedding site’s address (referrer origin) as part of the normal page request; and, on submit, the reservation details the visitor types (name, email, phone, party size, date, time, optional notes).
  • Human verification: inside the iframe, the form runs a Cap.js proof-of-work captcha from Bayle’s own captcha service at https://captcha.bayle.food (the challenge script and verification API are loaded from that host when the visitor fills in the form). No Google reCAPTCHA or other third-party captcha is used, and the plugin itself does not load this script on your site.
  • Why: to show live table availability and create the booking with the restaurant.
  • Terms of Service: https://bayle.food/legal/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://bayle.food/legal/privacy/

The plugin itself makes no server-side requests to Bayle, sets no cookies and adds no tracking.

Shortcode

Basic:

[bayle_booking]

Override the slug or language on one page:

[bayle_booking slug="demo-pizza" lang="fi"]

base_url can also be overridden, but only with an official `https://*.bayle.food` address; other values are ignored.

lang is matched to the restaurant's enabled storefront locales. If omitted, the plugin sends the WordPress site language.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bayle-booking-widget folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip from Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Bayle Booking Widget.
  3. Open Settings → Bayle Booking Widget.
  4. Set the restaurant slug (from Bayle restaurant CMS). Leave the widget base URL as https://widget.bayle.food unless Bayle gave you another host.
  5. Optionally lock this site in restaurant CMS → Booking widget allowed hosts.
  6. Insert the Bayle Booking block, or [bayle_booking], on a page.
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys in WordPress?

No. Keys stay on Bayle servers. WordPress only iframes the public widget URL.

Why is the form blank or “unavailable”?

The restaurant slug must be correct, the booking widget module must be on, and the restaurant must be active. If you locked allowed hosts in CMS, this WordPress hostname must be on that list.

Where does guest data go?

Name, email, phone, and notes are submitted inside the Bayle iframe to create the reservation. This plugin does not keep a copy in the WordPress database.
sections.changelog:
0.3.0

  • Block is now registered from block.json.
  • Shortcode base_url override only accepts official https://*.bayle.food hosts; anything else falls back to the admin setting.
  • Added suggested privacy policy text (Settings → Privacy).
  • Added translation template (languages/bayle-booking-widget.pot) and GPLv2 LICENSE.
  • Expanded External services section (including the captcha host) with Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.

0.2.0

  • Gutenberg block, translatable strings, and a production-ready install zip.

0.1.0

  • Initial release with settings page and iframe shortcode.
